prompt: Which reports establish that there were two frogs?
promptZh: 哪一組回報足以判定有兩隻蛙？

options.text: Two volunteers see a frog on the same stone at once.
options.zh: 兩人同時在同一塊石頭上看到一隻蛙。
options.whyZh: 這符合重複回報的條件，只算一隻。

options.text: One volunteer hears two calls from the far bank.
options.zh: 一人聽到遠端岸邊有兩聲蛙叫。
options.whyZh: 兩聲叫聲不等於看到兩隻蛙。

options.text: At noon, volunteers at opposite banks each see a frog.
options.zh: 中午，池塘兩端的志工各看到一隻蛙。
options.whyZh: 同時在相隔兩處看到蛙，可各算一隻，即使外觀相像。

options.text: One sighting is reported by the gate, and a second sighting is reported at the same spot much later.
options.zh: 入口旁有一筆目擊回報，很久以後，同一地點又有一筆目擊回報。
options.whyZh: 兩筆回報在同一地點、不同時段，可能是同一隻蛙，無法確定有兩隻。

explanationZh: 同時在相隔兩處看到蛙，可各算一隻，即使外觀相像。
evidence: Don’t merge two sightings just because the frogs look alike. Sightings at opposite ends of the pond at the same moment count separately. | If you only hear a call, record it separately
